defaults.source: Distilled from [swiperjs.com](https://swiperjs.com) — parameters, methods, events, every module and every framework binding — retrieved 2026-08-20.

core.title: Swiper core API
core.description: Swiper core API: all parameters, methods, properties and events, the Swiper Element web component, migration between major versions. Use when the request names Swiper, a slider or a carousel.
core.intro: The complete API surface. Parameters configure, methods control, events react — most integration questions are answered by one of the three.

modules.title: Swiper modules
modules.description: Swiper modules: navigation, pagination, scrollbar, autoplay, effects, virtual, zoom, thumbs, grid, free mode, keyboard, a11y. Use when the request names a Swiper module.
modules.intro: Features ship as modules you register explicitly — an unregistered module's options are silently ignored.

advanced.title: Swiper advanced features
advanced.description: Swiper advanced features: controller, history and hash navigation, parallax, lazy loading, DOM manipulation, custom plugins. Use when the request names Swiper parallax or a Swiper plugin.
advanced.intro: Less common modules, plus the plugin API for writing your own.

frameworks.title: Swiper framework bindings
frameworks.description: Swiper framework bindings: React, Vue, Angular, Svelte and Solid components with their props and slots. Use when using Swiper inside React, Vue, Angular, Svelte or Solid.
frameworks.intro: Each binding wraps the same core; what differs is how slides are declared and how the instance is reached.
